verdict.rationale: BILL S&E's own cards and spend management categorize every transaction, and the platform has budgets and transaction management. Real-time S&E event notifications exist, but only as a developer webhook feed, not a founder-facing live spend view. missing for 10: a documented real-time spend dashboard or report, breakdowns by team and by merchant, evidence that transactions appear the day they happen in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land

citations.quote: smart, flexible cards paired with AI-powered spend management—so every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant.
Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards. Manage transactions & reimbursements.
Subscribe to & receive real-time notifications for AP & AR events and S&E events.
